mapper.sql: FROM aid_canvas_publication p JOIN aid_canvas_publication_state s ON s.project_id=p.project_id JOIN aid_comic_project c ON c.id=p.project_id AND c.del_flag='0' WHERE 1=1 AND s.visible=1 AND s.blocked=0 AND s.published_id=p.id AND p.review_status='APPROVED' AND p.review_status=#{status} AND p.project_name LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%')
